question: List the names of all stations in Lyon, in alphabetical order.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM station WHERE city = 'Lyon' ORDER BY name

question: How many bikes have the status 'maintenance'?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike WHERE status = 'maintenance'

question: Give the plan name and monthly fee of every plan with a monthly fee above 20.
gold_sql: SELECT name, monthly_fee FROM plan WHERE monthly_fee > 20

question: List the names of all bike models that are not electric.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM model WHERE is_electric = 0

question: How many members joined in 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member WHERE joined_on >= '2025-01-01' AND joined_on <= '2025-12-31'

question: What is the name and capacity of the station with the largest capacity?
gold_sql: SELECT name, capacity FROM station ORDER BY capacity DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the total amount of all payments?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM payment

question: List the distinct payment methods that appear in the payment table.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT method FROM payment

question: How many bikes were purchased before 1 January 2024?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike WHERE purchased_on < '2024-01-01'

question: How many members live in Toulouse?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member WHERE city = 'Toulouse'

question: What is the average trip distance in km, rounded to 2 decimal places?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(distance_km), 2) FROM trip

question: How many maintenance records have not been resolved yet?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM maintenance WHERE resolved_on IS NULL

question: List the 3 cheapest plans by monthly fee, giving the plan name and the fee.
gold_sql: SELECT name, monthly_fee FROM plan ORDER BY monthly_fee ASC LIMIT 3

question: Give the name and opening date of every station that opened in 2023.
gold_sql: SELECT name, opened_on FROM station WHERE opened_on >= '2023-01-01' AND opened_on <= '2023-12-31'

question: How many bike models does the manufacturer Norvane have?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model WHERE manufacturer = 'Norvane'

question: What is the largest battery capacity in Wh among electric models?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(battery_wh) FROM model WHERE is_electric = 1

question: How many trips covered more than 15 km?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trip WHERE distance_km > 15

question: How many members were not referred by anyone?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member WHERE referred_by IS NULL

question: What is the total amount paid with the method 'card'?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM payment WHERE method = 'card'

question: Give the trip_id and distance of the 5 longest trips by distance, longest first.
gold_sql: SELECT trip_id, distance_km FROM trip ORDER BY distance_km DESC, trip_id ASC LIMIT 5

question: For each station, give the station name and the number of bikes currently assigned to it. Include stations that have no bikes.
gold_sql: SELECT s.name, COUNT(b.bike_id) FROM station s LEFT JOIN bike b ON b.station_id = s.station_id GROUP BY s.station_id, s.name

question: For each plan name, give the total amount paid by the members on that plan.
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(pay.amount) FROM plan p JOIN member m ON m.plan_id = p.plan_id JOIN payment pay ON pay.member_id = m.member_id GROUP BY p.plan_id, p.name

question: Which manufacturer has the most bikes in the fleet? Give the manufacturer name.
gold_sql: SELECT mo.manufacturer FROM bike b JOIN model mo ON mo.model_id = b.model_id GROUP BY mo.manufacturer ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: For each station that trips start from, give the station name and the average trip distance rounded to 2 decimal places.
gold_sql: SELECT s.name, ROUND(AVG(t.distance_km), 2) FROM trip t JOIN station s ON s.station_id = t.start_station_id GROUP BY s.station_id, s.name

question: How many trips ended at a station different from the one they started at?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trip WHERE end_station_id IS NOT NULL AND end_station_id <> start_station_id

question: For each model name, give the number of maintenance records recorded for bikes of that model.
gold_sql: SELECT mo.name, COUNT(*) FROM maintenance ma JOIN bike b ON b.bike_id = ma.bike_id JOIN model mo ON mo.model_id = b.model_id GROUP BY mo.model_id, mo.name

question: Which cities have more than 2 stations? Give the city and the station count.
gold_sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) FROM station GROUP BY city HAVING COUNT(*) > 2

question: Give the station name and the total maintenance cost for bikes assigned to that station.
gold_sql: SELECT s.name, SUM(ma.cost) FROM maintenance ma JOIN bike b ON b.bike_id = ma.bike_id JOIN station s ON s.station_id = b.station_id GROUP BY s.station_id, s.name

question: How many members who joined in 2025 have made at least one payment?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) FROM member m JOIN payment p ON p.member_id = m.member_id WHERE m.joined_on >= '2025-01-01' AND m.joined_on <= '2025-12-31'

question: Which station is the most common starting point for trips? Give the station name.
gold_sql: SELECT s.name FROM trip t JOIN station s ON s.station_id = t.start_station_id GROUP BY s.station_id, s.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: For each payment method, give the method, the number of payments and the total amount.
gold_sql: SELECT method, COUNT(*), SUM(amount) FROM payment GROUP BY method

question: Give the model name and the total distance ridden for the 3 models with the highest total distance, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT mo.name, SUM(t.distance_km) FROM trip t JOIN bike b ON b.bike_id = t.bike_id JOIN model mo ON mo.model_id = b.model_id GROUP BY mo.model_id, mo.name ORDER BY SUM(t.distance_km) DESC LIMIT 3

question: For each city, give the total number of trips that started from a station in that city.
gold_sql: SELECT s.city, COUNT(*) FROM trip t JOIN station s ON s.station_id = t.start_station_id GROUP BY s.city

question: Give the member_id and total amount paid for every member whose total payments exceed 300.
gold_sql: SELECT member_id, SUM(amount) FROM payment GROUP BY member_id HAVING SUM(amount) > 300

question: How many trips started in each month of 2025? Give the month as YYYY-MM and the number of trips.
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', started_at) AS m, COUNT(*) FROM trip WHERE started_at >= '2025-01-01' AND started_at < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY m

question: Give the name and city of every station that has at least one bike with the status 'maintenance'.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.name, s.city FROM station s JOIN bike b ON b.station_id = s.station_id WHERE b.status = 'maintenance'

question: What is the average monthly fee of the plans held by members living in Lille, rounded to 2 decimal places?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(p.monthly_fee), 2) FROM member m JOIN plan p ON p.plan_id = m.plan_id WHERE m.city = 'Lille'

question: Give the member_id and the number of trips for every member who has taken more than 25 trips.
gold_sql: SELECT member_id, COUNT(*) FROM trip GROUP BY member_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 25

question: For each manufacturer, give the manufacturer and the number of bikes with the status 'retired'.
gold_sql: SELECT mo.manufacturer, COUNT(*) FROM bike b JOIN model mo ON mo.model_id = b.model_id WHERE b.status = 'retired' GROUP BY mo.manufacturer

question: Give the issue and the number of maintenance records for each issue that appears more than 30 times.
gold_sql: SELECT issue, COUNT(*) FROM maintenance GROUP BY issue HAVING COUNT(*) > 30

question: Give the member_id and full name of every member who has referred at least 3 other members, together with the number of people they referred.
gold_sql: SELECT m.member_id, m.full_name, COUNT(r.member_id) FROM member m JOIN member r ON r.referred_by = m.member_id GROUP BY m.member_id, m.full_name HAVING COUNT(r.member_id) >= 3

question: For each station, give the station name, the number of trips that started there and the number of trips that ended there.
gold_sql: SELECT s.name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trip t WHERE t.start_station_id = s.station_id), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trip t WHERE t.end_station_id = s.station_id) FROM station s

question: Give the member_id of every member whose average trip distance is greater than the average trip distance across all trips.
gold_sql: SELECT member_id FROM trip GROUP BY member_id HAVING AVG(distance_km) > (SELECT AVG(distance_km) FROM trip)

question: Which model has the highest total maintenance cost per bike owned? Give the model name and that ratio rounded to 2 decimal places.
gold_sql: WITH c AS (SELECT b.model_id, SUM(ma.cost) AS total FROM maintenance ma JOIN bike b ON b.bike_id = ma.bike_id GROUP BY b.model_id), n AS (SELECT model_id, COUNT(*) AS fleet FROM bike GROUP BY model_id) SELECT mo.name, ROUND(c.total / n.fleet, 2) FROM c JOIN n ON n.model_id = c.model_id JOIN model mo ON mo.model_id = c.model_id ORDER BY c.total / n.fleet DESC LIMIT 1

question: Give the bike_id of every bike that has more than one unresolved maintenance record.
gold_sql: SELECT bike_id FROM maintenance WHERE resolved_on IS NULL GROUP BY bike_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

question: For each plan, give the plan name and the percentage of its members who have taken at least one trip, rounded to 1 decimal place.
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT t.member_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id), 1) FROM plan p JOIN member m ON m.plan_id = p.plan_id LEFT JOIN trip t ON t.member_id = m.member_id GROUP BY p.plan_id, p.name

question: What is the name and capacity of the station with the second-largest capacity?
gold_sql: SELECT name, capacity FROM station ORDER BY capacity DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

question: Give the member_id of every member who has made at least one payment but has never taken a trip.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM payment WHERE member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM trip)

question: For each station, give the station name and the longest number of days between a maintenance report and its resolution, for bikes assigned to that station. Ignore records that are not resolved.
gold_sql: SELECT s.name, MAX(julianday(ma.resolved_on) - julianday(ma.reported_on)) FROM maintenance ma JOIN bike b ON b.bike_id = ma.bike_id JOIN station s ON s.station_id = b.station_id WHERE ma.resolved_on IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.station_id, s.name

question: Give the member_id and full name of every member who joined in 2024 and whose first trip happened more than 120 days after they joined.
gold_sql: SELECT m.member_id, m.full_name FROM member m JOIN trip t ON t.member_id = m.member_id WHERE m.joined_on >= '2024-01-01' AND m.joined_on <= '2024-12-31' GROUP BY m.member_id, m.full_name HAVING julianday(MIN(t.started_at)) - julianday(m.joined_on) > 120
